name: io.github.HelgDemidov/refigure
description: Convert DOCX/XLSX to Markdown — native chart-data extraction, optional VLM for figures

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: Use Streamable HTTP transport instead of the stdio default

packageArguments.name: --mcp-auth-token-file
packageArguments.description: Bearer-token file (one 'token = caller_id' pair per line) — refigure-mcp refuses to start over HTTP without one

packageArguments.name: --mcp-http-host
packageArguments.description: Bind host — loopback by default; a non-loopback value is accepted but logs a startup warning
